molecule_selection.selection_rule: Select only source-verified ChEMBL molecule records under a documented cutoff and version; resolve and record every real ChEMBL ID before trace. Empty selection must be rejected by trace/expand entry points.

luteolin_case.holdout_rule: If selected as an unseen case, exclude its identity, Murcko scaffold, and all connected near-neighbor molecule clusters from development/training; do not inspect holdout labels for protocol choices.

label_policy.loader_compatibility: Current P0 label_policy.py validator is fixed to Ki/Kd and does not support this Ki-only copy; Phase 02-02 must implement strict non-empty Ki/Kd subset validation, mutually exclusive complete endpoint coverage, and preserve the default policy before this copy can be consumed.

support_policy.formal_readiness_requires: all configured per-split class and cluster minima; otherwise blocked

split_policy.selection_rule: Freeze source, molecule IDs, endpoint, thresholds, seed, holdout identities, and support rules before examining validation/test labels or outcomes; never retune from holdout results.

pilot.budget_accounting: Cumulative across the entire pilot batch; UniProt caps are separately cumulative across the batch.

formal_expansion_budget.gate: Any expand/freeze entry point must reject while status is pending; Phase 02-03 records resource trial evidence and creates a new explicitly versioned budget decision before formal expansion.

sequence_policy.on_missing_or_overlength: unsupported_or_blocked_with_reason; never silently truncate or mark ready
